Going back to the simpler first query grid, I'm re-examining the row and column label positions and matching them to the colored regions—top-right region reads 4, middle region reads 2—trying to find a consistent rule that fits both examples.

Checking region uniformity across several training examples, each region does consistently share one color, confirming a per-region rather than per-cell rule. Now I'm trying to figure out which specific label within each region actually determines that shared color.
